documents.title: Notice Of The 41St Annual General Meeting Scheduled To Be Held On Wednesday, 30Th September, 2026 Through Video Conferencing, Other Audio-Visual Means (OAVM)
Listing Approval From BSE Limited & National Stock Exchange Of India Limited For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Rs 2/- Each Under Preferential Basis.

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of 700 crores for Q1 FY27, with an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and sales volumes of 5,200 tons. The company is undergoing a corporate restructuring to form Tieramet Limited to focus purely on the copper business. Management has proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next two years (FY27 and FY28) and expects volume growth of 12% to 15% for the full year. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial results, with revenue from operations at Rs. 70,507.54 lakhs and an EBITDA margin of 5.43%.

guidance.claim: The company expects volume growth of 12% to 15% for the full year.
guidance.quote: So, | think we should be looking at between 12% to 15% growth in terms of volume for the whole year now.

guidance.claim: The company had projected an average price of 1,300 rupees a kilo at the beginning of the year.
guidance.quote: 1,300 rupees a kilo is the average which we had projected at the beginning of the year.

guidance.claim: The company hopes to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% going forward in the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving 5,000 crores of revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its value-added product share to 69% over the next four years.
guidance.quote: Like | said, over the next 4 years, we will go to 69%.

guidance.claim: The company estimates export contribution to be between 12% and 15% for the year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We have achieved almost 5% EBITDA margin during the last two quarters. We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects 20% volume growth and a 5% price increase to drive its 25% growth target.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: The company plans to increase its share of value-added products to 66% by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

guidance.claim: The demerged copper company is projected to reach a turnover of 5,000 crores in 3 years.
guidance.quote: The Demerge Company, which will have only the copper business, will reach 5,000 crores in 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to consume around 2.4 million metric tons of copper by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is expected to double from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons in the next five years.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market in India is estimated to grow at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Existing customers are looking to increase volumes and double their capacity in the next three years.
demand_outlook.quote: As of today, we see a lot of demand. All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The transition from primary to recycled copper in India is accelerating due to growing sustainability focus and supply constraints.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: The company foresees a major copper shortage after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: The availability, while right now there is no shortage for the next 2 or 3 years for copper. But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects the copper business to grow rapidly and India to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: And like we've been discussing, the copper business is going to explode like nobody's business. Advait had mentioned that we'll become the second biggest consumer of the copper in the world.

demand_outlook.claim: Global copper consumption is predicted to double to 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has proposed a capex of 40 crores over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects its capacity expansion to become operational between April and June of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion will increase capacity from 35,000 to 45,000 tons.
capex_expansion.quote: From 35,000 to 45,000 tons. It is not for this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to form a new wholly owned subsidiary called Tieramet Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: We are going to form a new company called Tieramet Limited, which will be a wholly owned subsidiary of Bhagyanagar India.

capex_expansion.claim: The copper business will move to Tieramet, which will be demerged, while Bhagyanagar Copper will merge with Bhagyanagar India.
capex_expansion.quote: All the copper business will move from Bhagyanagar Copper to Tieramet and then Bhagyanagar Copper will be merged with Bhagyanagar India, while Tieramet is demerged outside.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently undergoing capacity expansion.
The company plans to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
capex_expansion.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest around 10 crores into a plastic recycling project.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding recycling verticals for aluminium and plastic.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are also adding recycling verticals of aluminium and plastic.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and a PAT margin of 2.87% in the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved a value-added product share of 63% and an EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: The company's margins are expected to be more stable in percentage terms than in rupees per kilo terms.
margins_costs.quote: So, our margins are going to be more stable in percentage terms than in rupees per kilo terms.

margins_costs.claim: The removal of customs duty from January 1, 2025, has helped increase margins.
margins_costs.quote: Also, the customs duty has been removed from 1st January 2025, so that has also helped us increase our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin for Q1FY27 stood at 5.43%.
The company's value addition per kilogram was 116 INR in Q1FY27.
The company's EBITDA per kg for the year was around 43 rupees, rising to 62 rupees per kg in Q4.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards. With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an operational EBITDA margin of 46% and a PAT margin of 2.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Our operational EBITDA margin is 46%, our PAT margin is 2.1%, and our PE ratio is 17.71%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has completed adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is now online.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's CTC wires capacity is about 80 metric tons a month and will increase to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons in the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: We have achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company recorded a sales volume of 5,278 metric tonnes in Q1FY27.
The company's capacity reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year with its new facility near Hyderabad.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's copper sales volume increased by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has finalized a first round of fund raising of 52 crores, with funds expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: The second tranche of the fund raise will likely occur around March after the demerger.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's debt is projected to be around 325 crores in 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: The projection is showing that around 325 crores will be the debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised 52.25 crore Rupees through a preferential issue to non-promoters.
The company's working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is looking at a fundraise of approximately 150 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The increase in equity was achieved through retained earnings rather than dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade route disruptions and material shortages occurred in the first two months of the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: A GST case has been filed against the company due to the retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's performance is subject to risks such as competition and the performance of the Indian and international economies.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the Company's ability to successfully implement its strategy

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing of raw materials from the Gulf has decreased, and sourcing from other countries has slowed down due to transshipment issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: Whatever sourcing from Gulf has come down. Sourcing from other countries has slowed down because of transshipment in and around Gulf.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company expects its first-quarter volume to be marginally lower than the fourth quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: My volume in the first quarter might be marginally lower than fourth quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's working capital and borrowings will increase alongside its turnover.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our working capital will keep going up along with the turnover, and our borrowings also will go up, but hopefully not in the same ratio as our turnover.

management_commitments.claim: The company has proposed a capex of 40 crores over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to execute a complete digital transformation over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
management_commitments.quote: We have achieved almost 5% EBITDA margin during the last two quarters. We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to increase its share of value-added products to 66% by the end of next year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

management_commitments.claim: The company is looking to execute a fundraise of roughly 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
